new_features.pct_unmapped: unclassified share in county_landcover.csv; percent of valid pixels
new_features.window_len_next_{h}h: number of available points in the existing [t,t+h] weather window
new_features.is_full_next_{h}h: 1 if the existing [t,t+h] weather window reaches t+h, else 0
new_features.has_weather_at_t{h}h: 1 if exact weather at t+h is available, else 0
